claim: As of PR #1821 (Nov 2025), GIE's 'EPP standalone mode' still depends on the InferencePool CRD -- only the Gateway API dependency is removed, not the Kubernetes control-plane dependency.
stance_target: current standalone EPP is a partial decoupling (drops Gateway API) rather than a full decoupling from Kubernetes CRDs
quoted_support: For this stage, EPP standalone mode still uses InferencePool. That's why I didn't put it in a distinct chart. Later, if we decide to have a standalone EPP without any k8s crd, I will refactor it to a distinct helm chart. To clarify, this PR just removes gateway api dependency, inferencepool api is still there.

claim: The PR was retitled from 'helm support for EPP standalone mode with Envoy Proxy' to 'helm support for sidecar injection in EPP', and its final scope is a generic, vendor-agnostic sidecar-proxy-injection hook in the EPP Helm chart rather than an Envoy-specific or standalone-specific chart.
stance_target: GIE's Helm tooling approach to proxy deployment is generic/pluggable rather than tied to a single proxy vendor
scope_conditions: GIE Helm chart PR review, Nov 2025
quoted_support: isn't all needed here to enable the above is to allow adding a sidecar proxy to the epp deployment? Yes. I've updated it to enable additional sidecar proxy injection.
